title: @splunk/react-ui - 5.3.0
content:
Date

An input for selecting a date.

Overview
Examples
API
Test Hooks
Date API
Props
append

Append removes rounded borders and the border from the right side.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
canClear

Include an "X" button to clear the value.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
defaultValue

Default date to display. Set this instead of value to make the Date uncontrolled.

PropType:	string
Required:	no
describedBy

The id of the description. When placed in a ControlGroup, this automatically set to the ControlGroup's help component.

PropType:	string
Required:	no
disabled

Add a disabled attribute and prevent clicking.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
elementRef

A React ref which is set to the DOM element when the component mounts and null when it unmounts.

PropType:	oneOfType(func, object)
Required:	no
error

Highlight the field as having an error. The border and text will turn red.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
highlightToday

Highlight today's day.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
inline

When false, display as inline-block with the default width.

PropType:	bool
Default:	true
Required:	no
inputId

An id for the input, which may be necessary for accessibility, such as for aria attributes.

PropType:	string
Required:	no
inputOnly

Whether or not to display the calendar menu.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
labelledBy

The id of the label. When placed in a ControlGroup, this automatically set to the ControlGroup's label.

PropType:	string
Required:	no
locale

Locale set by language and localization specifiers.

PropType:	string
Default:	'en_US'
Required:	no
name

The name is returned with onChange events, which can be used to identify the control when multiple controls share an onChange callback.

PropType:	string
Required:	no
onBlur

A callback for when the input loses focus.

PropType:	func
Required:	no
onChange

Return event and data object with date string (in YYYY-MM-DD format) when a date is selected.

PropType:	func
Required:	no
onClick
PropType:	func
Required:	no
onFocus
PropType:	func
Required:	no
onKeyDown
PropType:	func
Required:	no
prepend

Prepend removes rounded borders from the left side.

PropType:	bool
Required:	no
value

Setting this value makes the property controlled. An onChange callback is required.

The value must be "" or in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. To simplify creation of these strings, Date provides a Moment.js formatting string:

moment().format(Date.momentFormat);
PropType:	string
Required:	no
